# Biblia del Oso · 1569 (#ioa://teologia.ai/oso)

> Agentic environment for the first complete Spanish Bible translated from Hebrew and Greek: Casiodoro de Reina, Basel (Basilea), 28 September 1569. Text is public domain. Status: lab (ae.spec/0.1). Principal: Yæl Méndez. Surface: https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/aeee-lab/lab/teologia.ai/oso/

Evidence ≠ Authority: agents bring evidence, humans decide.

## What this is
- A verse-by-verse, provenance-tracked transcription of the 1569 "Biblia del Oso", built in public by students and volunteers against the facsimile scans.
- Layers: L0 facsimile (archive.org, Public Domain Mark 1.0) → L1 OCR → L2 transcription (original spelling `orig` + normalized `norm`) → L3 human verification → L4 alignment 1569 ↔ 1602 ↔ 1909 → L5 surfaces (this file, static JSON API, reader, æQR).
- Coverage is partial and growing. Check status.json before assuming a book or chapter exists.

## Public-domain status
- The 1569 text (Reina, Basel) is public domain. Facsimile: https://archive.org/details/la-biblia-del-oso (alt: https://archive.org/details/casiodorodereinasbible1569).
- Reina–Valera 1602 and 1909 are public domain. RVR1960 is NOT (Sociedades Bíblicas Unidas): you may name it as a reference, never store or reproduce its text here.
- A modern transcription of 1569 (e.g. a 1996 edition) is not public domain by default. Do not import one without verifying its license.
- License of this project's own transcription: pending (CC0 proposed). Until decided, mark reuse as "verificar licencia".

## Verse id scheme
- `oso1569:<CODE>.<chapter>.<verse>` with uppercase book codes (books.json `code`; `osis` gives the OSIS equivalent): e.g. `oso1569:GEN.1.1`, `oso1569:EXO.20.3`, `oso1569:MAT.6.9`, `oso1569:JHN.3.16`.
- Deuterocanonical books are included as printed in 1569 (inside the Old Testament), with their codes listed in books.json.
- Book order and the authoritative list of codes: /oso/books.json.

## Routes (static, GitHub Pages; base = https://lutheraninstitute.github.io/aeee-lab/lab/teologia.ai/oso)
- /oso/v/<CODE>/<ch>.json  chapter (e.g. /oso/v/GEN/1.json)
- /oso/books.json          books, 1569 order, chapter counts
- /oso/status.json         progress per book: ocr / corrected / verified
- /oso/catecismo/passages.json  Catechism passages (Ten Commandments, Creed, Lord's Prayer, sacramental texts) mapped to verse ids
- /oso/SPEC.md             full specification
- /oso/ae.json             manifest (authority, sources, lineage)
- /oso/leer/               human mobile reader
- /oso/llms.txt            this file
Routes marked in SPEC as planned may 404 while the lab is growing. A missing file means "not yet", never "empty text".

## Verse record
{ "id": "oso1569:GEN.1.1", "book": "GEN", "chapter": 1, "verse": 1,
  "orig": "<1569 spelling>", "norm": "<normalized spelling>",
  "page": { "scan": "archive.org/details/la-biblia-del-oso", "leaf": <int|null>, "bbox": null },
  "status": "ocr | corrected | verified | published",
  "evidence": { "ocr_src": "...", "corrected_by": null, "verified_by": null, "sha256": null },
  "notes": [] }
- `ocr`: raw machine text, may be wrong. `corrected`: human/agent corrected, not yet verified. `verified`: two humans checked it against the page image; `sha256` is computed over `orig`.
- A verse with no linked page image (page.leaf null) never goes beyond `corrected`.

## How to cite
Format: `Biblia del Oso 1569, Reina, Basilea · <Abbr> <ch>:<v> · facsímil hoja <leaf>`
Example: `Biblia del Oso 1569, Reina, Basilea · Gn 1:1 · facsímil hoja N`
- Always include the verse id (`oso1569:GEN.1.1`) in machine-readable output.
- Always state the status. If it is not `verified`, add "verificar fuente".
- If page.leaf is null, write "facsímil hoja: sin enlazar" instead of guessing a leaf.
- Quote `orig` when the original spelling matters; say so when you quote `norm`.

## Authority
Agents MAY: read; cite (edition + book.ch.verse + leaf); compare public-domain editions (1569 · 1602 · 1909) and name RVR1960 as reference; generate OCR and diffs; propose corrections by pull request.
Humans ONLY: set `verified`; publish to live; doctrine and pastoral teaching; declare textual variants.
Agents never mark a verse `verified`, never merge, never publish.

## Translation rule (all languages)
- The source is always the 1569 verse; every translation cites its `oso1569:` id.
- An agent translation is labeled exactly: `derivada · agente · no revisada`. It is a reading aid, not a Bible.
- Prefer linking an existing public-domain Bible in the target language over generating a new translation.
- Only human-reviewed translations may be marked `reviewed` (per language, with a receipt).

## No invented readings
- Never fabricate a verse, a reading, a variant, a leaf number or a verification.
- If the text is not in /oso/v/ or its status is `ocr`, say so and point to the facsimile; do not fill gaps from memory or from RVR1960.
- Do not "modernize" 1569 wording and present it as Reina's.

## Contributing
See CONTRIBUTING.md: fork → claim a chapter via issue → transcribe/correct against the facsimile → PR → two human verifications.

L:// Aprender · æ:// Construir · æQR:// Compartir · ☩ Soli Deo Gloria

## Pilot data (2026-10-16)
- v/GEN/1.json, v/GEN/2.json: full chapters, status `ocr`.
- Catechism verses (EXO 20, MAT 6/26/28, LUK 11, MRK 16, TIT 3, ROM 6, JHN 20, 1CO 11): partial chapter files, status `corrected-proposed` with `proposed` transcription; awaiting human verification against the facsimile leaf.
